items.name: Battle axe
items.description: A heavy axe with a 3′ haft.

items.name: Club
items.description: A 2–3′ length of stout wood with a heavy head.

items.name: Crossbow
items.description: A bow mounted horizontally on a wooden shaft, with a winding mechanism to pull back the string and nock a quarrel. May be kept in the loaded position.

items.name: Dagger
items.description: A 1′ long, two-edged blade.

items.name: Hand axe
items.description: A 2′ long hatchet suitable for use in melee or for throwing.

items.name: Lance
items.description: A 10′ shaft of strong wood tipped with a pointed, leaf-shaped blade. Designed for use on horseback, but may also be used on foot.

items.name: Longbow
items.description: A bow of around the wielder's height, typically 6′ in length. Fires arrows.

items.name: Longsword
items.description: Typically double-edged and around 3–4′ in length.

items.name: Mace
items.description: A 2–3′ haft with a studded, flanged, or spiked head.

items.name: Polearm
items.description: A long haft (8′ or longer) tipped with a stabbing point or slashing blade. Many types of polearms exist, but all are treated as one weapon type for simplicity.

items.name: Shortbow
items.description: A bow of around 4′ in length. Fires arrows.

items.name: Shortsword
items.description: 2′ blades designed as thrusting and stabbing weapons.

items.name: Sling
items.description: A strap of leather or fabric used to twirl and launch normal stones at high speed.

items.name: Spear
items.description: A haft of strong, flexible wood, typically around 5′ long, tipped with a stabbing metal point.

items.name: Staff
items.description: A stout length of wood, typically 6–8′ long. Staves often double as walking sticks, but those designed for combat may be shod with metal end caps.

items.name: Two-handed sword
items.description: A great, heavy sword, 5–6′ in length.

items.name: War hammer
items.description: A 2–3′ haft tipped with a heavy metal hammer head, often with a spike on one side.

items.name: Leather
items.description: A breastplate of hardened leather, with soft leather covering the rest of the body.

items.name: Bark
items.description: Thick layers of tough, lichen-encrusted bark, with flexible joints of young birch bark or bottle corks laced together. Typically only available in small size, designed for mosslings.

items.name: Chainmail
items.description: A suit of interlocking metal rings over a backing of quilted fabric.

items.name: Pinecone
items.description: An intricate scale-work of hardened pine scales threaded onto a cloth backing. Typically only available in small size, designed for mosslings.

items.name: Plate mail
items.description: Metal plates shaped to the contours of the body. Sections of chainmail provide flexibility at the joints.

items.name: Full plate
items.description: Perfectly interlocking plates of metal over a backing of chain mail and padding. Only the most expert armourers can craft full plate armour, and each suit must be tailored and balanced for a specific individual (takes 1 month). Wearing another person's full plate armour is awkward and only grants AC 16.

items.name: Shield
items.description: Made of metal or reinforced wood.
